CRIMINAL MISCELLANEOUS No.82890 of 2024  Arising Out of PS. Case No.-1566 Year-2022 Thana- BHAGALPUR COMPLAINT   District- Bhagalpur  ======================================================
 Mahendra Kumar Das S/O Baleshwar Das R/O Village Domuhni, P.S-  Taljhari, Dist.- Dumka( Jharkhand)
 ... ...

Petitioner/s  Versus  1. The State of Bihar  2. Munni Kumari Daughter of Anirudh Prasad Ram, wife of Mahendra Kumar  Das Resident of Village Uday Rampur (Kodwar), P.S. Ghogha, District -  Bhagalpur Pin Code-813205.
 ... ... Opposite Party  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Ashutosh Kumar, Adv  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Ram Sevak Choudhary  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE JUSTICE SMT. SONI SHRIVASTAVA  ORAL ORDER 5 04-08-2025 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned counsel for the OP.No.2 and the learned APP for the State.
2. Petitioner apprehends his arrest in a case registered for the offences punishable under sections 323,498A of the Indian Penal Code.
3. The case is one under section 498A and the petitioner is husband.
The complaint case discloses an allegation of demand of dowry and torture.

4. The matter had been sent to the Patna High Court, Mediation Center for reaching an amicable settlement between the parties and it would appear from the Memorandum of Agreement dated 15.07.2025 passed in Mediation Proceeding no. 604 of 2025 that the issues has been resolved between the parties and a decision for one time settlement has been arrived at, upon payment of Rs.
11 lakh to the opposite party by the Patna High Court CR.

MISC. No.82890 of 2024(5)
dt.04-08-2025 petitioner in installments.

As per the terms and conditions the first installment of Rs. 2 lakh was to be paid by way of bank draft on the date of hearing of the present bail application and the same bearing Draft No. 368491 has been handed over to the learned counsel for the OP.NO.2 in court and a copy thereof is being kept on record.

5. It has been submitted on behalf of both the parties that schedule of payment and other terms and conditions as agreed upon by the parties by way of said memorandum of the agreement would be strictly adhered to.

N.K/- (Soni Shrivastava, J)
